raw_text: Quick thread on the LoC drone footage circulating today. I ran the video through frame analysis and the results are damning: the military figures are composited at a different frame rate than the background terrain. The thermal overlay is fake — real FLIR footage has consistent noise patterns that this lacks. Classic information operation targeting India-Pakistan tensions.
clean_text: Frame analysis of the LoC drone footage shows military figures composited at different frame rate than terrain. Thermal overlay lacks consistent FLIR noise patterns indicating fabrication.
